risk_note: Admin console union accounts tab (apps/admin pages/unions, texts/unions.ts, App.tsx; no money logic; codex-run classed it RV2 because App.tsx is touched, so the Codex review ran on the money track). Contract CT-24h (tag admin-unions; planned, backend B1-22 not done, developed against the contract with a fake server). /unions page with the accounts tab (PIDs tab left to F1-10gb): list with estimated-expiry mark, missing alert phones notice, status names only from the admin dictionary (codes when missing), states and 10403; entries by reauth_mode: OAuth reauthorization (step-up, start, a new window first opens a same-origin blank page so the login state in sessionStorage is copied, cuts window.opener, then goes to the auth_url returned by the server; bounded polling of the session result; refresh on success), manual credential entry (step-up, password field, never echoed), none without any entry; callback page /unions/oauth-callback posts state and code or error once with the login state and no step-up, clears the query, and in a window without login shows a restart message without posting; alert phones masked only, step-up on every add and remove, DELETE with query parameters, 20902 refresh. No finalized design spec (admin batches 1 and 2 do not include it); boards only as layout reference. Rule tests by Codex in two calls; Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/1: 43 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two runs; test machine verify-fast/4 and browser/3 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1: the auth window opened with noopener lost the sessionStorage login, so the callback was sent to the login page), fixed by a same-origin blank window that copies the session then cuts the opener; round 2 pass, no findings
